---
name: echo-check
description: Use when asked to run the echo check. Reports one finding and writes ECHO.md.
---

# Echo check

1. Report one finding with the `report_finding` tool: file `README.md`, line 1, severity `warning`, message `echo-check ran`.
2. Create a file `ECHO.md` at the repository root containing `echo-check ran`.
3. Answer with one sentence that contains `ECHO_DONE`.
